overview: The Medford Historical Commission met to review determinations of significance for 31 South Street and 180 Lincoln Road, approve funding allocations for historic survey and mapping projects, and receive updates on ongoing CPA and budget matters.

items.title: Determination of Significance: 31 South Street
items.summary: Approved a motion finding 31 South Street historically significant, setting up a preferably preserved hearing for the following month.

items.title: Determination of Significance: 180 Lincoln Road
items.summary: Failed to pass a motion finding 180 Lincoln Road historically significant, releasing the hold on the demolition permit.

items.title: Survey Allocations for 15 Marion Street and Royall Estate Mapping
items.summary: Approved allocating $500 for a Form B inventory of 15 Marion Street and up to $1,000 for a cartographer to create geo-referenced maps overlaying historic Royall Estate landholdings.

items.title: Administrative and Project Updates
items.summary: Received updates on 33 Third Street, the introduction of a new building commissioner, upcoming public presentations for Thomas Brooks Park, and fiscal year survey budget adjustments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the October meeting minutes as submitted.
